caption:
Mark Zuckerberg is officially having a moment again. Meta's new AI assistant Muse just crossed 10 million downloads after a wild year of layoffs and huge spending. Analysts say he won the narrative, but the actual money return is still pending. 

Would you trust a chatbot built by Zuck? 🤖

@openai

Source: Business Insider

post.news: Meta launched its new AI assistant Muse, which hit over 10 million downloads and beat OpenAI to market.
post.take: He won the narrative, but the bill is huge. A very expensive game of throwing spaghetti at walls.
post.insight: Big tech companies can spend billions on unproven bets and still bounce back if one product hits the jackpot.

claims.evidence: Muse, the long-awaited Meta AI agent, became a breakout hit. A week after it launched, it shot to the top of the app store, and has since achieved more than 10 million downloads in North America. The team was stunned to have beaten OpenAI to market
